title: Service Properties Trust Announces Quarterly Distribution on Common Shares
summary: NEWTON, Mass., July 09, 2026--Service Properties Trust (Nasdaq: SVC) today announced a regular quarterly cash distribution on its common shares of $0.05 per share ($0.20 per share per year), which is unchanged from previous distribution levels after giving effect to the recent five-for-one reverse share split.
